name: zepp-otp-auth-app
description: Time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) on Amazfit / Zepp OS watches
author: Andreas Remigius Schmidt <remigius42-github.dcds7@aleeas.com>

scripts.bridge: npm run build && cd build/zeus && zeus bridge
scripts.build: npm run generate-licenses-data && npm run generate-arc-frames && npm run compile && npm run check:engine && cd build/zeus && zeus build
scripts.dev: npm run generate-arc-frames && npm run compile && cd build/zeus && zeus dev
scripts.preview: npm run generate-arc-frames && npm run compile && cd build/zeus && zeus preview
scripts.lint: npm run lint:prettier && npm run lint:cspell && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:oxlint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:engine
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:prettier && npm run lint:fix:oxlint
scripts.check:engine: (test -f src/setting/licenses.js || npm run generate-licenses-data) && node bin/check-engine.mjs
scripts.version: node bin/sync-app-version.mjs && prettier --write src/app.json && git add src/app.json
